notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.9.4 - Release/Demo Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented robots from being able to headbutt
[*] Fixed an issue that disabled the lava from rising on Pyro Plunge
[*] Removed red hue from robot faces
[*] The Grappling Hook no longer retracts closer than it attaches; this will prevent it from entering situations where it let robots join the RRSA (Robo-Royale Space Administration) without permission 🚀
[/list]

[h2]A quick note[/h2]
There are currently some bugs with Steam Remote Play Together that we are trying to fix. 

[b]For now:[/b] If you are playing as a Remote Play guest and your controller stops putting in inputs, trying Alt+Tabbing out of the host's game stream and Alt+Tabbing back in.

[h2]Find a bug or issue?[/h2]
Report problems with the game on our [url=https://discord.gg/5fuyqb2rgD]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.9.3
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] First Kickstarter custom face added.
[*] Added names to the credits.
[*] Added 321 countdown that plays at the beginning of each match.
[*] Added a final achievement (Ultimate Robot - Unlock all other achievements).
[*] The Grappling Hook part now lets you control its movement! See what it does to pool balls for an extra surprise!
[*] The Post-Battle Screen has been completely renovated.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where mouse click inputs would highlight categories in the Settings menu, but not properly shift to the highlighted category’s submenu
[*] Lava now properly rises and falls on Pyro Plunge when hazards are enabled
[*] Fixed a hazard collider on Dynamic Depot that could perpetually trap robots
[/list]

[h2]Find a bug or issue?[/h2]
Report problems with the game on our [url=https://discord.gg/5fuyqb2rgD]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.9.2.1 - Achievement Edition!
notes.content:
[h2]This patch adds new achievements![/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Professional Camper:[/b] Win a 4-Player match without losing any lives			
[*] [b]Modular Bots:[/b] Play and complete a match after changing at least three settings
[*] [b]You Were the Chosen One!:[/b] Play and complete a 1v1 on Pyro Plunge using only melee weapons				
[*] [b]Archaeologist Approved:[/b] Knock another player off Pyro Plunge while swinging with a Grappling Hook.			
[*] [b]Pinball Expert:[/b] Get knocked by at least 3 hazards in a row and survive.			
[*] [b]Quick Draw:[/b] Knock players off the stage using a Dodgeball Launcher 5 times in one match.				
[*] [b]Make Wilt Proud:[/b] Knock another player into a Pylon and have the rebound send them off the stage.			
[*] [b]Hasta la Vista:[/b] Knock another player off the stage, and get burnt by the lava right after.
[/list]

[h2]Find a bug or issue?[/h2]
Report problems with the game on our [url=https://discord.gg/5fuyqb2rgD]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.9.2
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Custom Game/Match Options’ sliders now change with movement instead of button inputs (this aligns it with other UX schemes in the current menus)
[*] Max timer value increased to 5:00 (from 3:00)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue keeping mouse inputs from being able to exit and reenter the pause menu’s Settings menu
[*] Screen resolution dropdown now works more consistently across all control schemes
[*] Fixed an issue that was keeping many death VFX from playing (robots will now visibly splash and/or explode on death ːsteamhappyː)
[/list]

[h2]Find a bug or issue?[/h2]
Report problems with the game on our [url=https://discord.gg/5fuyqb2rgD]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 0.9.1
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now return to Player Select from the Controller Disconnect menu (this solves soft-lock situations during Steam Remote Play sessions)
[*] Can now go back in menus by holding B (Xbox) or Circle (Playstation)
[*] Loading screen now has tips & tricks
[*] Loading screen added between starting the game from the main menu and Player Select (this should greatly improve animated transitions on lower end systems)
[*] Players on the same team can no longer choose the same face
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an unfair spawning position on Pyro Plunge
[*] Increased Billiards Brawl minimum camera distance
[*] Improved Grappling Hook’s interactions with explosive barrels
[*] Game time is now properly paused during Steam Remote Play disconnects
[*] Fixed a bug preventing players from moving in the end-of-match screen after using the Propeller Hat
[/list]

[h2]Find a bug or issue?[/h2]
Report problems with the game on our [url=https://discord.gg/5fuyqb2rgD]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Demo Patch - The Friendly Fire Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Hope you're enjoying the demo so far! We're dropping a huge demo update to show off a piece of what we've been cookin' 🤖

[h3]But first, an announcement...[/h3]
We’re going to be running a booth at [b]TooManyGames 2024[/b]! You can also find Lockjaw in the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44973690/sale/TooManyGames2024]convention’s Steam collection[/url][/b].

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Select the color and face of robots! Robots that choose the same color team up.
[*] Play the new level, Pyro Plunge!
[*] Try out the new Mini Pylon and Bomb Arm parts!
[*] Pause the game mid-match when you need a break!
[*] Change the new video and audio settings! You can access them from the main menu.
[*] Check out the credits to see who works on the game!
[/list]
[h2]Changes/Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The previous map, Waterworks, has been swapped out for Pyro Plunge.
[*] The existing robot parts have been completely rebalanced and redesigned (Propeller Hat, The Tenderizer, Battering Ram, Dodgeball Launcher, Tank Treads, and Grappling Hook). Experiment with them and discover their new abilities!
[*] The glow outline on the robots have been stylistically swapped out; robots are now set to have saturated paint colors.
[*] All UI elements have been completely polished and overhauled.
[*] Robots now have 3 seconds of spawn invulnerability.
[*] Robots now spawn at the spawn point furthest from other robots.
[/list]

[h1]Steam Remote Play Together Tips[/h1]
[list]
[*] When playing Steam Remote Play, send an extra message to your friend to make sure they get an invite!
[*] If Remote Play is performing weirdly, double check your game's resolution and restart the game.
[/list]

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]
[list]
[*] We're working on getting a Discord community up for Lockjaw soon, so look out for that! In the meantime, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Abduct3dMonkeys]X (Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/abductedmonkeys/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@abductedmonkeys]TikTok[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@AbductedMonkeys]YouTube[/url]!
[*] Lockjaw will be going live for funding on Kickstarter in June; more info to come.
[*] See us at TooManyGames from June 28th-30th!
[/list]

[h3]Until next time![/h3]
[b]- The Abducted Monkeys Team[/b]
